# Source manifest and provenance

**No external data is used.** Every record is generated by `generator/generate_data.py` from the fixed seed `20261022`.

| Item | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Employees, names, e-mails | Synthetic. Names are picked from short invented lists in `generator/config.py`. | E-mails use the reserved domain `example.com`. No real person is represented. |
| Cost centres, budgets | Synthetic. Budget = headcount × 3,600 USD. | |
| Leave policies, expense policies, approval rules | Synthetic, written for this project (`config.py`, `rules.py`). | Values are plausible, not copied from any employer's policy. |
| Public holidays | Illustrative list in `config.py` (25 dates, 4 countries). | **Not an official calendar.** Only used so business-day counting has holidays to exclude. Public holiday calendars were used for schema inspiration only; nothing was downloaded or redistributed. |
| Receipts | Metadata only (file name, hash). No receipt files exist. | |
| Bootstrap 5.3.3 | `npm` package `bootstrap`, MIT licence | Vendored in `workflow/static/workflow/vendor/` with its licence file. Only the compiled CSS and JS were copied. |

Fields discarded / transformations: none (no external dataset was ingested).

Regenerate: `python -m generator.generate_data` (see `data/manifest.json` for seed, scale, command, row counts and SHA-256 checksums).
